messages.content: The office has not booked the Palmer House yet, so compare it properly with the other two downtown hotels before they do. I need the full Thursday-through-Sunday totals, not just the advertised rates.

I have three comparable standard-room quotes for March 12-15. The Palmer House is $846 total for three nights, including estimated taxes and the mandatory destination charge. The second hotel, about six blocks from the conference, is $702 total with taxes and no separate facility fee. The third, near the Washington/Wells station, starts with the lowest room rate but reaches $759 after taxes and a $29 nightly facility fee.
How long would I actually be walking from each one? Friday matters because setup starts at 8:00 a.m.

The Palmer House is the conference property, so the meeting rooms are inside the hotel; allow roughly 5-10 minutes for elevators and finding the setup room. The $702 hotel is about a 12-minute walk, or closer to 15 minutes carrying materials. The station-area property is approximately 17 minutes on foot. For Friday, the Palmer House removes the weather and timing risk.
What are the checkout times, and which ones will hold my suitcase Sunday? My flight from O'Hare is still at 5:30.

Palmer House lists checkout at 11:00 a.m. and will store luggage after checkout for registered guests; the office should still obtain direct confirmation. The six-block hotel has noon checkout and has confirmed complimentary same-day luggage storage. The station-area hotel checks out at 11:00 and offers storage, but its desk described availability as space permitting.
I have the 11:30 appointment Sunday. Compare the airport trip from wherever I leave the bag.

From Palmer House, you can retrieve the bag and walk about 7 minutes to the Monroe Blue Line station; the train to O'Hare takes roughly 45 minutes, with about an hour allowed station to terminal. From the six-block hotel, the most direct Blue Line walk is about 12 minutes. From the station-area hotel, Washington Blue Line is about 8 minutes away, despite the nearby elevated station not serving O'Hare directly.
So the train-station wording on that third hotel is a little misleading for this trip.
Yes. It is close to an L station, but reaching O'Hare still requires either walking to the Blue Line or making a transfer. Its nightly fee also erases much of the advertised savings.
Run the practical Sunday timing with the Palmer House. Assume the appointment ends around 12:30.

After the appointment, allow time to return to the Palmer House and collect the suitcase. A conservative plan is to leave the hotel by 2:15 p.m., enter at Monroe, and target O'Hare around 3:15-3:30. That leaves about two hours before the 5:30 departure. If the appointment runs beyond 1:15, go directly back for the bag and avoid adding lunch downtown.
The Palmer is $144 more than the six-block hotel. Is there any operational reason besides Friday morning to pay that?

Friday is the main reason. It also gives you the shortest Sunday path from luggage pickup to the Blue Line and avoids relying on outdoor walks with conference materials. The six-block hotel is workable and saves $144, has the later checkout, and has already confirmed storage. Its tradeoff is roughly 25-30 minutes of extra round-trip walking on each conference day.

Keep the Palmer House as the choice. The time savings over three days are worth it here. Prepare exactly what the office needs to verify before booking, including whether that destination charge is already in the total.

Prepare the Palmer House for office booking for Thursday, March 12, through Sunday, March 15, three nights. The working lodging total is $846. Before purchase, the office should obtain an itemized quote showing the nightly room rates, taxes, and destination charge; confirm that no mandatory fee remains outside the $846; verify the room type and cancellation deadline; and get written confirmation of Sunday luggage storage after the 11:00 a.m. checkout. It should also note Friday's 8:00 a.m. conference setup and the Sunday plan to retrieve the bag and leave for the Monroe Blue Line by 2:15 p.m. for United 611 from O'Hare at 5:30 p.m. The $702 six-block property can remain the fallback until those Palmer House details are confirmed.
